item.content:encoded:
Gradient Descent · Friday, August 14, 2026 · 7 articles · ~3 min read

Today's Brief

Think of AI model prices like a falling domino chain, where one cheaper model knocks down the prices of others, changing the budgeting game for developers and researchers. As AI prices drop, investors are taking notice, pouring money into AI-focused funds and stocks, which in turn drives the market toward record highs. Now that affordable AI models like Gemini 3.7 Flash are within reach, what's the one workflow or process in your own project that you've been putting off due to costly AI tools, and how will you revisit it today?

📊 AI & Data Tools

Gemini 3.7 Flash lands with coding gains and undercuts its three-week-old predecessor's price by 50%

Gemini 3.7 Flash is 50% cheaper than its predecessor and beats Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra in coding benchmarks. This changes the budgeting decision for developers and researchers choosing between AI models, as they can now consider Gemini 3.7 Flash as a more affordable option. → Read

Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-VL-3B: A 3B Vision-Language Model That Reads Screens, Grounds Objects, and Calls Tools On-Device

LFM2.5-VL-3B is a 3.1B-parameter vision-language model that achieves 80.7 on ScreenSpot-v2 and lifts RefCOCO grounding from 57.1 to 87.9. This changes the on-device deployment workflow for vision-language tasks, as developers can now integrate LFM2.5-VL-3B into their applications for improved performance and functionality. → Read

How to Utilize OKF Efficiently to Enable Knowledge Exchange Among LLMs

Google's Open Knowledge Format (OKF) can be reused for agent-to-agent hand-off of pre-tokenized integer arrays between Qwen2.5-Coder models. This changes the knowledge sharing workflow between large language models (LLMs), as developers can now use OKF to enable more efficient and effective knowledge exchange between different models and sizes, such as 7B, 3B, and 1.5B models. → Read

📈 AI in Finance

Japan Power Futures Get Boost as Utilities Hedge Price Risk

Japanese companies are increasingly using power futures to manage risk from fuel-price volatility, with short-term contracts rising for four straight months. This changes the risk management strategy for utilities and energy companies, which can now use power futures to hedge against price fluctuations. → Read

Kushner’s Thrive Fund Grows Sevenfold to $3.7 Billion on AI Bets

Thrive Capital’s 2022 early-stage venture capital fund has grown to $3.7 billion, a sevenfold increase, thanks to early bets on AI companies like OpenAI. This changes the investment strategy for venture capital firms, which can now prioritize AI-focused startups for potential high returns. → Read

Easing Inflation and AI Rally Push Stocks Toward Records | The Close 8/13/2026

Easing inflation and a rally in AI stocks are driving the market toward record highs, with experts weighing in on the trends. This changes the portfolio optimization strategy for investors, who can now consider adding AI stocks and adjusting their inflation expectations to maximize returns. → Read

🎧 Podcasts

AINews

SpaceXAI has introduced Grok 4.6 and Grok @Bot, marking a significant new entrant in the AI teammate category. This changes the AI-powered tools available for teamwork and collaboration, allowing users to consider Grok 4.6 and Grok @Bot for their workflow and decision-making processes today. → Listen
